name: medical-study-tracker
description: Decision engine for paid clinical-trial participation, ranked by net cash kept, cash velocity, and downtime — with a childcare-by-friend-city and payout-timing model.
_hive_notes: Phase-1 build target: Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui, purely local (localStorage) persistence for v1 — no Supabase/backend (see design-discussion.md §9). lib/scoring.ts is the framework-free engine — wire the UI to scoreAll(). Seed from data/*.json. prototype/net-value-model.html is the working reference. Mirror personal-drone repo conventions.
